8294.title: Catalog replacement after a smaller successful discovery
8294.rootCauseOneLine: Successful catalog refreshes unconditionally replace the persisted model arrays, without a completeness signal or smaller-snapshot safeguard.
8294.proposedFix: Establish discovery completeness or choose a bounded retention/removal-confirmation policy before promoting suspicious smaller snapshots.
8294.caveats: Reproduced twice at the server catalog-store boundary with real migrated SQLite and synthetic host RPC; live OpenCode activation and account-specific model counts remain unverified. No automatic fix because retention semantics require a product/architecture decision.
